name: Jet Amplifier - Retaliation
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Retaliation capability.

61240.name: Flying Device I · Retaliation
61240.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
When Retaliating, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
